title: Artemis crewed landing (NASA site criteria)
summary: Best option: land at Peak near Shackleton on 2028-01-27 12:00 UTC (GREEN, worst case GREEN). Sunlight 100-100% of the mission, Earth contact 100%, longest darkness 0 h.

landing.shadow_risk: Sun 0.7 deg above the local horizontal at landing: any depression or slope steeper than 0.7 deg facing away from the Sun is in shadow. Craters smaller than about 10 m are not resolved by the 5 m terrain: check the ellipse with 1 m imagery (IM-2 Athena, 2025, ended in a 20 m crater).
